name: Men Of Valor
overview: The Scriptures portray men of valor as those empowered by the Lord to face overwhelming challenges without fear, trusting in His presence and strength. From the encouragement given to Joshua to confront enemies confidently, to the angel's proclamation to Gideon as a mighty man of valor, these men demonstrate courage rooted in God's deliverance and guidance. Figures like Jephthah embody this valor despite complex personal backgrounds, showing that God’s calling transcends human limitations. Ultimately, this valor is undergirded by divine strength and wisdom, as seen in the Psalms and anchored in the eternal Word of God.
